validator-bot: spike: /invoke v2 schema rejects in eu-west1 — 64 rejects in 10m, 19 auto-reroutes to degen. sample bundle attached.
kevin: quick scan: majority are `tools` (array) vs `tool` (object). many are single-element arrays. client agents pre-1.3 batch tool outputs.
maria: we flipped validator to strict in router canary yesterday for better guarding, but this seems like a compatibility regression.
jamie: proposal: implement a canary-only `soft_coerce_attempt` in router — if reject reason is only pluralization or single-element-array-for-object, try a non-destructive re-validate after coercion and only escalate if still fails.
sasha: good. also add `schema_category` tag (pluralization/type_mismatch/missing_required) so console can show meaningful breakdowns. ops wants top-5 patterns in dashboard.
kevin: billing note: current fallback double-bills tokens (orig + degen). filing BILL-20260325-1 to dedupe and add `fallback_tag` metadata for attribution.
lia: I'll message the large offender (acct: acme-inc) to advise agent upgrade and offer a lenient parser interim.
maria: short-term plan: jamie -> PR for soft_coerce + category tag and canary deploy to EU; maria -> bump sampling 1%->10% for 30m; kevin -> billing ticket; lia -> outreach.
jamie: PR 4388 opened: includes classifier, soft_coerce_attempt behind canary flag, metric `schema_category`, and gate change to require 3 pluralization rejects in 5m before auto-reroute.
sasha: after canary, schedule 30m postmortem + decision doc about adding per-route `lenient_shape` toggle in Console.
maria: action items set. ETA canary in 20m.
kevin: ack :thumbsup:
